hypothesis_text: Across major altcoins (BNBUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT, XRPUSDT), sharp 4-hour idiosyncratic return deviations relative to Bitcoin (abs(return_4h_btc_neutral) > 0.01) exhibit predictable mean reversion over 1h to 4h forward horizons, especially when aggressive taker volume turns against the shock (gate_opposite_side on taker_buy_ratio_1h) and localized intraday volatility is elevated (gate_tail on volatility_garman_klass_1h).
narrative: When an altcoin decouples sharply from Bitcoin over a 4-hour window, the move is predominantly driven by short-term speculative momentum, retail liquidations, or isolated news events rather than fundamental cross-market repricing. As aggressive taker flow reaches exhaustion and begins trading against the direction of the recent move (flow turning opposite to the 4h residual return), informed market makers step in to provide liquidity. Under elevated Garman-Klass volatility, the pricing dislocation represents transient variance shock absorption, accelerating the reversion of the speculative overshoot back toward its coin-specific rolling regression baseline against BTC. Conversely, if taker aggressors remain aligned with the move, continuation may persist, which our side-tied controls (gate_high and gate_low on taker_buy_ratio_1h) specifically isolate.
research_rationale: Anchor predicate abs(return_4h_btc_neutral) > 0.01 was evaluated on the majors panel (15m bars, 2024-06 to 2025-08), yielding 34,888 matched rows (22.2% match rate) across 409 independent active days and 7,451 episodes. Firing distribution is symmetric across positive shocks (17,029 bars) and negative shocks (17,859 bars). Autocorrelation collapses rapidly from 0.723 at 1h to -0.0095 at 4h, confirming that idiosyncratic 4h moves dissipate within the 4h horizon. In the alpha cemetery, the anchor gene return_4h_btc_neutral has 416 trials with 40 T1 survivals (9.6% survival rate); dominant kill codes were T0.04-IC-STAT (245) and T1.20-REGIME-FILTER (61). We address T0.04 by introducing event-conditioned gating via taker_buy_ratio_1h and volatility_garman_klass_1h, which prunes low-conviction noise while clearing T1 event observation floors (projected 266 to 278 days >= 250). In gene_knowledge.priors, taker_buy_ratio_1h on opposite_side is the pre-registered prior trigger for cross-sectional reversal (n=60, confidence sufficient, shrink weight 0.75). To adhere strictly to side-tied gate rules, gate_opposite_side is accompanied by both gate_high and gate_low on taker_buy_ratio_1h as required controls. Volatility_garman_klass_1h gate_tail is added to capture volatility absorption during extreme idiosyncratic moves, avoiding queue collision with existing depth-based experiments. Full search scope is selected to allow the automated composition grid to explore multi-gene interactions between trigger and volatility absorption mechanics.
